author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror illustrators wanted - paid opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

author: OC Illustration
title: Hiring live illustrators for events in Michigan
content: 🎨 Michigan artists! OC Illustration is looking for live illustrators to join our team! Hi everyone! My name is Olivia, and I own OC Illustration, a live illustration studio based in Michigan. We provide elegant, minimalist fashion-style illustrations at weddings, corporate events, and private celebrations across the Midwest! We’re growing our team and looking for talented, enthusiastic artists to join our small roster of contract illustrators in Michigan. Paid, part-time, contract work. Approximately 2–3 events per month. Most events are 4–6 hours, primarily evenings and weekends. Events throughout Michigan, with potential opportunities in surrounding states. Training provided. No prior live event experience required! Looking for artists with strong foundational drawing and gesture skills, comfortable with markers or alcohol markers, fast learners, personable and reliable. Interested? Comment or fill out the application: https://www.ocillustration.com/workwithus
